event_text: An identity-verification provider used by EasyEquities tells it that an unauthorised party got into the provider's systems; EasyEquities disables the link the next day
EasyEquities closes the attacker's initial access route and blocks internet access to the affected server, it later tells clients, TechCentral reports
notes: Purple Group says it identified the incident the same day (c019).

event_text: EasyEquities emails every client about a security incident affecting some of its systems and restricts client logins and some services
EasyEquities says all client funds are accounted for and that it is keeping the platform offline while it completes checks
EasyEquities' help page, updated, says clients still cannot log in and some withdrawals may be delayed
EasyEquities updates its help page with its plan for bringing the platform back step by step, and says withdrawals reopen only after payment-provider checks
notes: The page gives no time zone.

event_text: EasyEquities sends clients a formal data-protection notice saying a small number of accounts were specifically targeted, TechCentral reports
notes: TechCentral published at 17:16 UTC; the notice time is not given.
